name: Schrödinger's In Neon Green
description: A dream-state matrix environment resembling an empty neon-lit arcade. Shifting walls of glowing green code and retro cabinets provide erratic cover. A bright white door with an exit sign stiletto hangs impossibly in the distance.

zones.name: The Floor
zones.description: The open neon grid where the players materialize.

zones.name: Cabinet Clusters
zones.description: Rows of retro arcade cabinets offering cover.
